def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    sr=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1]
    sc=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    sep=Counter([grid[r][0] for r in sr]+[grid[0][c] for c in sc]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rs=[r for r in sr if all(v==sep for v in grid[r])]
    cs=[c for c in sc if all(grid[r][c]==sep for r in range(h))]
    rb=[0]+[r+1 for r in rs]; re=rs+[h]
    cb=[0]+[c+1 for c in cs]; ce=cs+[w]
    colors=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v!=sep)
    marker=min(colors,key=colors.get)
    bg=colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c]==marker for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))==2 else bg
             for x,y in zip(cb,ce)] for a,b in zip(rb,re)]
